decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans 2916/1a submitted 30 September 2010 therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - Visibility splays of 2.4m wide to the west and 1.2m wide to the east of the access shall be provided, the depth measured from the back of the footway and the widths outwards from the edges of the access, and no fence, wall or other obstruction to visibility exceeding 0.6m in height above the surface of the adjoining highway shall be erected within the areas of such splays.
Condition : 4 - The crossover shall not exceed 2.4m wide.
Condition : 5 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the development hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Formation of vehicle access and works to existing gate and boundary wall.
